metadata.title: Push Test Plan to ADO
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Push the approved test plan to Azure DevOps. Creates requirement-based suites, creates new test cases via wit_create_work_item (for Payoneer custom fields), adds them to the target suite, links to the work item, updates existing test cases, and handles obsolete cases with user input.

output.description: Test cases created/updated in ADO, linked to work item, requirement suite created in Releases

prerequisites: Test cases approved by user (testCases.approved = true)
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Create requirement-based suite in Releases using Python script create_requirement_suite.py (needs PAT)
PAT flow: check for credentials.json, if missing ask user for PAT, create credentials.json file. .gitignore already excludes it
Create new test cases via mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_write (NOT testplan_create_test_case) to support Payoneer custom fields
Add created test cases to the resolved target suite
Link test cases to work item via mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_link_write
Update existing test cases (for Update-classified ones) via mcp__azuredevops__testplan_test_case_write (update steps)
Link Skip-classified cases to the work item as well
Handle obsolete cases: ask user to choose — prefix title with 'TO REMOVE -' / leave as-is / other action
Test Category rules: Use E2E only when Automation Test Type is Automation, otherwise use Regression
Use mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_write for individual updates, NOT wit_update_work_items_batch

read: create_requirement_suite.py (Python script for requirement suite creation)

tools: mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_write - Create new test cases with Payoneer custom fields
mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_link_write - Link test cases to work item
AskQuestion - Ask user about obsolete case handling and PAT
bestPractices: Always create test cases via wit_work_item_write, not testplan_create_test_case, for Payoneer custom field support
Use individual updates (wit_work_item_write), never batch updates
Verify each ADO operation succeeded before proceeding to the next
Record ADO IDs for all created/updated items for the report step
Handle errors gracefully — log failures but continue with remaining items
Clean up credentials.json in the report step, not here
Test Category: E2E only for Automation Test Type = Automation, otherwise Regression

substeps.name: Create requirement-based suite in Releases
substeps.description: Use create_requirement_suite.py to create a requirement-based suite in the Releases section
actions: Check for credentials.json — if missing, ask user for PAT and create the file
.gitignore already excludes credentials.json
Run create_requirement_suite.py Python script with the work item ID and releases_suite_id from qaConfig
Record the created requirement suite ID and name

substeps.name: Create new test cases
substeps.description: Create test cases classified as New via wit_work_item_write
actions: For each test case classified as New in coverage mapping:
Create test case via mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_write (NOT testplan_create_test_case)
Include Payoneer custom fields: Test Category (Regression or E2E based on Automation Test Type), area path, iteration path
Test Category rules: E2E only when Automation Test Type is Automation, otherwise Regression
Set test case steps: ActionStep for setup, ValidateStep for assertions
Record the created test case ID for each

substeps.name: Add test cases to target suite
substeps.description: Add all newly created test cases to the resolved target suite
actions: Use mcp__azuredevops__testplan_test_suite_write to add each created test case to the target suite
Verify each addition succeeded

substeps.name: Link test cases to work item
substeps.description: Create links between test cases and the original work item
actions: Use mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_link_write to link each new test case to the work item
Use 'Tests' link type for the relationship

substeps.name: Update existing test cases
substeps.description: Update test cases classified as Update with new steps
actions: For each test case classified as Update in coverage mapping:
Use mcp__azuredevops__testplan_test_case_write to update the test case steps
Use mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_write for individual field updates (NOT batch)
Record the updated test case ID for each

substeps.name: Link skip cases to work item
substeps.description: Link test cases classified as Skip to the work item
actions: For each test case classified as Skip:
Use mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_link_write to link existing test case to the work item
This ensures the work item tracks all relevant existing coverage

substeps.name: Handle obsolete cases
substeps.description: Ask user how to handle test cases classified as Obsolete
actions: Present each Obsolete-classified test case to the user
Ask user to choose handling: prefix title with 'TO REMOVE -' / leave as-is / other action
Apply the chosen action for each obsolete test case
Use mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item_write for individual updates if title prefix is chosen

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: All New test cases were created via wit_work_item_write (not testplan_create_test_case)
Verify: All test cases are linked to the work item
Verify: Test Category rules applied correctly (E2E vs Regression)
Verify: Individual updates used, not batch
Verify: All ADO operation results recorded (IDs, errors)
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Create requirement suite in Releases (needs PAT) -> Create new test cases via wit_work_item_write -> Add to target suite -> Link to work item -> Update existing test cases -> Link skip cases -> Handle obsolete cases with user input. Each ADO operation is verified individually before proceeding.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Test cases (approved), coverage mapping, qaConfig (releases_suite_id, services_suite_id), target suite path
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: adoPush object with created/updated/linked IDs and any errors
fields: Information Produced: adoPush.createdTestCases (array of {localId, adoId, title}), adoPush.updatedTestCases, adoPush.linkedTestCases, adoPush.requirementSuiteId, adoPush.obsoleteHandling
Decisions Made: Obsolete case handling per item, PAT source (existing vs user-provided)
Notes: adoPush.errors (any failed operations), Test Category assignments
